name: Vanndara
description: Few charts agree on Vanndara, whose primary casts a brown-dwarf glare across the local dark. Old claim buoys tumble here, their registries expired and their owners gone. Something in the belt reflects too regularly, and the guild pays for a second look.

stars.name: Cold Ember
stars.description: A brown-dwarf of 0.0489 solar masses, planet-like atmosphere against the dark. It radiates leftover formation heat, cooling a fraction each century. Its wind shapes every orbit in the system, and the weather follows it.

planets.name: Kilnhollow
planets.description: Cracked highlands sprawl beneath a thin sky, every crater a kept record. Dust devils wander the basins, and the night side glitters with ice. One moon occults on a schedule that matches no ephemeris, and navigators plan around it.

moons.name: Quartz Pebble V
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Tidal stress warms its interior, and frost cracks map the strain. Shepherd resonances with the rings betray a denser core than expected.

moons.name: Rust Flint III

moons.name: Hollow Boulder V
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Tidal stress warms its interior, and frost cracks map the strain. Outgassing vents frost the trailing face a little more each orbit.

dwarfPlanets.name: Gilded Lesser 50
dwarfPlanets.description: A small cold world holding its round shape against the dark. Frost plains stretch unbroken to a horizon that curves too soon. Its thin story is written entirely in impact craters.

belts.name: Quartz Belt
belts.description: Countless fragments grind slowly against each other in a broad torus. Collisional dust hazes the lane, and larger bodies keep eccentric courts. Old mining claims dot the denser knots, most of them long expired.

comets.name: Long Tear 76
comets.description: A dirty snowball falling sunward on its long appointed round. Each passage sheds glittering debris the scopes track for seasons. Its tail leans away from the star like a banner in a gale.
